sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University and Hampton University are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. Clark Atlanta University, located in Atlanta, has an undergraduate enrollment of 3,603 students, while Hampton University in Hampton enrolls slightly more undergraduates, totaling 3,727. These differences highlight variations in size, cost, and location between ClarkAtlanta vs Hampton.
